note: Huron NF campground near Curran (Alcona County), small and lightly used, on 16-acre Horseshoe Lake (~9-11 sites), with a boat access site and a short lake-loop trail; the Ann Arbor ORV and Snowmobile Trailhead is nearby. Best for vans, tents and small RVs under 25 ft: access is tight, so survey on foot before bringing a larger rig. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated June 4, 2026): $10/night (confirmed), Senior/Access 50% off the single site, all first-come (confirmed; no recreation.gov listing), vault toilets + potable water (confirmed), season May 3 - Nov 30 (new).
